posten.title: Log in to Posten
posten.description:
1. Open this link in a browser and log in with Vipps or your phone number:

{authorize_url}

2. After logging in, your browser is redirected to an address starting with `posten://login?code=...`. The page may fail to open — that is expected.

3. Copy that whole address (or just the `code` value) and paste it below.

postnord.title: Log in to PostNord
postnord.description:
1. Open https://app.postnord.no in a browser and log in with Vipps.

2. Open developer tools (F12) → **Network**, reload the page, click the `shipments` request, and under **Request headers** copy the whole value of the `Cookie` header.

3. Paste it below. You will need to repeat this if the session cookie expires.

error.invalid_auth: Login was rejected. Please try again with a fresh code/cookie.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the carrier. Check your connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This carrier account is already set up.
